$ graphene maintenance repair fx
exit 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
graphene maintenance repair: maintenance repair is not implemented, deliberately
  There is no repair. A tool that rewrites records it has decided are wrong is a tool that can destroy the evidence it was pointed at, and it does so at exactly the moment nobody is in a position to check its work.

What exists instead:
  maintenance reindex   rebuilds derived state from the records
  backup restore        rebuilds a whole store from a verified copy
  store csr -verify     says what is actually wrong, before anything acts
